data_or_decision: User signs up with email/password or phone OTP
Country selected from button group, defaults to NG, stored as businesses.country_code
Category choice immediately seeds selectedCapabilities with CATEGORY_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES[key]
evidence: StepCategory.tsx:437-445 sets category and seeds capabilities

data_or_decision: User can toggle any capability on/off during onboarding. All caps available during 30-day trial regardless of tier.
evidence: StepFeatures.tsx:186-188 isLocked=false — all toggleable during trial
unresolved_questions: All capabilities unlocked during trial regardless of tier — is this intentional?

data_or_decision: Creates business row with subscription_tier='free', status='pending', trial_ends_at=now+30d
evidence: trial_ends_at uses inline Date.now()+30d, not TRIAL_DAYS constant
unresolved_questions: trial_ends_at computed inline, not from TRIAL_DAYS constant — divergence risk

data_or_decision: User-selected capabilities persisted as business_capabilities rows with is_enabled=true. Priority: user selection → template metadata → CATEGORY_DEFAULT_CAPABILITIES → ['scheduling']
evidence: service.ts:130-148 plain INSERT (not upsert), service client bypasses RLS

data_or_decision: Dashboard UI prevents toggling growth/business caps when tier is free (client-side only). Trial bypasses all tier checks.
evidence: RLS policy business_capabilities_owner_update checks only owner_id, not tier
No server-side tier enforcement on capability writes
unresolved_questions: Tier enforcement is UI-only. RLS does not enforce tier. A browser client could bypass.

data_or_decision: Admin can grant any capability regardless of tier. Override recorded in capability_overrides. Audit logged.
Server component queries business_capabilities (is_enabled=true) and capability_overrides, injects into DashboardProvider context
evidence: DashboardProvider.tsx:67-131 pure context wrapper, no DB queries

data_or_decision: Sidebar shows items whose capabilities intersect business.capabilities. Ungated items always shown. Tier-blocked items show upgrade badge.
evidence: Sidebar.tsx:574-643 capability filtering and tier-based upgrade section

data_or_decision: Only 7 of 92 pages use useRequireCapability(). 85 pages have no capability gate — accessible by direct URL.
evidence: useRequireCapability used in: recurring, broadcasts, membership, queue, loyalty, referrals, waitlist
NOT used in: appointments-management, orders, tickets, events, payments, invoices, chat, surveys, polls, etc.
unresolved_questions: Is it intentional that 85 dashboard pages have no capability gate?

data_or_decision: Zero API routes enforce capability access. All check only auth and business ownership. A client can create bookings, orders, tickets etc. even if the capability is disabled.
evidence: grep -r hasCapability|checkCapability|getEnabledCapabilities app/api/ returns zero matches for access gating
Only lib/bot/ code calls getEnabledCapabilities for gating
unresolved_questions: Should API routes enforce capabilities? Or is UI/bot gating considered sufficient?

data_or_decision: Bot loads same business_capabilities truth as dashboard. Stored in session_data for flow duration.
Filters to user-facing caps, skips those without backing data. 0-1 cap → direct flow. 2+ caps → capability selection menu.
evidence: capability-selection.flow.ts:44-205 builds menu from filtered capabilities

destination.symbol: intent used for entity pre-fill, not routing

data_or_decision: Regex first (BOOKING/ORDERING/PAYMENT/TICKETING patterns), then Claude Haiku LLM if PostHog flag enabled. Intent does NOT override capability routing.
evidence: bot.service.ts:939 routing based on getFirstStepFromCapabilities, not intent
Intent pre-fills session_data entities but does not control which flow runs
unresolved_questions: Intent classification does not check if matched capability is enabled — silently ignored if not in menu

data_or_decision: Customer requesting disabled capability sees generic 'I didn't understand that' — never told the capability exists but is disabled.
evidence: capability-selection.flow.ts:266 returns errorMessage without mentioning the capability
unresolved_questions: Should the bot say 'this business doesn't offer X' instead of 'I didn't understand'?

data_or_decision: Bot does not check subscription_tier for individual capabilities. Relies entirely on business_capabilities rows. If a free-tier business has a growth capability enabled (e.g., via trial or override), the bot exposes it.
evidence: bot.service.ts:903-916 loads capabilities from business_capabilities only
No tier check in capability loading code
unresolved_questions: Is this intentional? Trial businesses get all caps, but after trial ends, are growth caps automatically disabled?

data_or_decision: Session stores current_step, session_data (capabilities, entities, step_history), version (CAS). Conversation log capped at 100 entries.
'stop/quit/exit/end' → deactivate + 'Send Hi to start'. 'cancel' → go back one step. 'start over/restart/reset' → deactivate + new session.
unresolved_questions: No test coverage for CANCEL_WORDS/RESTART_WORDS in executor

data_or_decision: 'talk to a human/agent/person' triggers escalation if chat capability is enabled. If chat not enabled, escalation silently fails (no message to customer).
evidence: chat-handoff.ts forwards to business owner WhatsApp + email
Silent failure when chat not enabled
unresolved_questions: Silent failure when chat not enabled — customer says 'talk to someone' and gets no response about handoff

source.symbol: direct Supabase client write to business_capabilities

data_or_decision: Capability changes via dashboard toggle write directly to DB (no API route). Bot and dashboard both re-query on next request — changes propagate on next session/page load.
evidence: layout.tsx:168-174 re-queries on each page load
unresolved_questions: No API route — writes go directly from browser to DB via RLS. Tier enforcement is client-only.

data_or_decision: When user selects paid plan and pays, verify route sets tier and ends trial. But no automatic capability downgrade exists when trial ends without payment.
evidence: No cron job or trigger that revokes growth/business capabilities when trial expires
unresolved_questions: After 30-day trial ends, capabilities enabled during trial remain enabled in business_capabilities. No automatic downgrade mechanism found.
